recipe.title: Sauteed Garlic and Tomato Lentil Salad
recipe.description: This sauteed garlic and tomato lentil salad is a delicious and healthy way to enjoy lentils! Colorful, bright, and fresh flavors.
ingredients: 1/2 cup dry light bulgur (light just refers to the coarseness of the grain)
1/4 cup citrus/vinaigrette dressing (I used a lemon tarragon dressing)
instructions: Cook the lentils and the bulgur according to directions, using vegetable broth instead of water. When cooked, combine and set aside.

Saute the tomatoes, garlic, and olive oil over low heat for 15 minutes or until the tomatoes and garlic are soft and fragrant. Remove from heat. Add the lentils, bulgur, and parsley to the pan and stir to combine.
Season with dressing, salt and pepper, and lemon juice. Serve hot or cold.
